tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Successful bidder has to provide the vehicle as per the requirement laid down in the tender notification of KS&DL otherwise, the company will take the following actions: a. Cancel the Work Order. b. The said company will be debarred and will not be allowed to participate in the KS&DL tender for a period of three years. c. Forfeiting the EMD, Security Deposit and in addition to the same invoke the Performance security executed by the bidder. d. Recoveries of additional expenses incurred from the pending bills of the transporter or through legal action for the tenure of the contract period for default by the transporter.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
KS&DL reserves the right to cancel / alter / modify / reject any / all tender without offering any explanation to anyone.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Call for supporting documents in claim of documents/information uploaded in tender
For terms and conditions and any clarification refer bid document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Nature of business & standing please specify your experience in the following areas. Supported by experience certificates.a. Clearing, forwarding & transportation of Raw-materials/Liquid materials from different ports/STC. b. Transportation of Soaps & Detergents Solids from KSDL or any other industry. c. Transportation of materials of Public & Private sector undertakings. d. List of clients to be furnished.

Tenderer has to issue certificate for having accepted all the terms & conditions of the tender unconditionally on the tenderers letterhead, which is MANDATORY otherwise offer shall be liable for rejection
Technical bid format is filled and uploaded
No. of own vehicles (Minimum Twenty vehicles should be owned by the firm or owner. Copy of the documents for owning vehicles should be enclosed such as Invoices, RC) compulsorily.

Statutory Documents to attach:a. PAN Number. b. GST Registration Certificate. c. Financial turnover of the bidder should be minimum Rs. 22 lakhs (Avg. Turnover for last 3 preceeding financial years to be taken together) and should be certified by chartered accountant, which is MANDATORY otherwise offer shall be liable for rejection. d. Upload GST returns filed, profit and loss statement during the last three years certified by CA compulsorily. e. Upload the IT Returns for last 3 years compulsorily.

Others -- GST returns filed for the last three years
Others -- Profit and loss statements during the last three years
